references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses to cast four gold rings for the ark, which Bezalel here carries out in practice.
A corresponding instruction regarding gold rings for the table of showbread, illustrating the recurring pattern of rings for carrying poles among the holy furnishings of the tabernacle.
Bezalel also makes four gold rings for the table in the same manner, demonstrating the consistent execution of God's design for the tabernacle equipment.
The instruction concerning gold rings on the incense altar, which follows the same pattern of rings for carrying poles.
The making of the gold rings on the incense altar, paralleling the work done with the rings of the ark.
